nom: COSRX 5 PDRN Collagen Intense Vitalizing Serum with Adenosine & Niacinamide

avis.texte: Love this! I felt like it helped with wrinkles, and it didn't upset my sensitive skin! Will purchase again!

I'm hooked! I use it head to toe. It's significantly reduced the length and depth of my wrinkles and eradicated the crepeiness on my thighs. I took off a star because I prefer lightly scented products

COSRX asked what I wanted to try and I was thrilled to get this! It absorbs quickly and my sensitive skin loves it. It's made my skin feel and look plumper and is so refreshing to use. It's really hydrating and gives my skin a wonderful glow. It's on my list as a must have now.
Hydrating and soothing. Did not irritate my very sensitive skin. Wonderful formula.

I adore COSRx so when they asked ne to try this, I couldn't say no and I am so glad I got this! My skin looks vibrant, my pores are getting less noticeable and my fine lines are looking even finer. This stuff hydrates and firms and I will be a repeat buyer. . . as soon as it is back in stock. *(^o^)*
Texture seriously improved. Does a really great job boosting moisture as a toner in the dry winter air. Pores feel less rough. Didn't irritate my skin and used it weekly.

This is my new favorite product from COSRX. Since I started using it, my skin has felt more hydrated and firmer. My two daughters were so impressed that they have also started using it. Multiple people have commented on how my skin is "glowing. " I've also noticed that the dark circles under my eyes have decreased. I used to never leave the house witho it make-up and concealer, but now, I find I'm doing it multiple times a week. I can't say enough about how much I love this product.

This is a thin, watery serum that almost becomes creamy as you apply it into the skin, and it's been really nice to use it to layer both in the morning and evening due to how thin and easy it sinks into the skin. I have combo, sensitive skin from tretinoin in my routine, and this did not sensitize my skin further at all. My skin has definitely looked more bouncy after I apply it, but unfortunately I need to make sure I am using enough hydrating layers on top of this as this isn't really hydrating enough on its own for me, and my skin can get dry and flaky by the end of the day, especially as it is winter and my skin is drier. I would recommend this to people with normal to oily skin since I have noticed a difference in my skin after using it, and for dry skin folks I definitely recommend layering it with other hydrating layers (I've been loving this with multiple layers of toner, the snail mucin serum and a thick moisturizer topped off with aquaphor). I'm sure I will love this even more in the summer when my skin is not feeling as stripped from the cold air.

I'm brand new to PDRN and was very excited upon trying it. The serum is packed with adenosine, a natural occurring chemical in the body and PDRN, which is usually salmon DNA to improve elasticity and revive tired skin. My first application left me impressed. It has hyaluronic acid so it's important to wet your face first to avoid pilling. My skin definitely became softer and looked more hydrated. I use a plethora of anti aging products, so I can't say I noticed any difference in fine lines or wrinkles; however that shouldn't stop you from trying this serum out, especially if you have congestion or skin that appears dull. I definitely would recommend if you're new to PDRN and want a good starter product with simple key ingredients!

avis.titre: Leaves my skin bouncy and hydrated!
avis.texte: Love love love the consistency of this product. It's so lightweight - like liquid, not gel. It also absorbs into the skin well. I apply at night before my moisturizer and it works well underneath. My skin feels soft and hydrated right after I apply it. When I wake up my skin still looks hydrated, glowy, and bouncy! I haven't see too much of a difference with my pores but I think it's too early to tell. I'm looking forward to the effects after continued use. I've been using it about 2 weeks now and I love it and will be adding to my routine. I recommend if you are looking for a remedy to dull skin and dehydrated skin.
i keep recommending this to everyone that asks about my skin, much like all my other cosrx products! this is truly magic, my pores have never looked better

i'm a firm believer of serum. very happy to receive the new product to try. it absorbed to skin quickly without heavy feeling. skin looks brighter and more supple after one week use. perfect to layer in winter time.

avis.titre: The COSRX 5 PDRN Collagen Intense Vitalizing Serum
avis.texte: The COSRX 5 PDRN Collagen Intense Vitalizing Serum is a rich, silky, smooth, ultra hydrating serum. I've been using for eight weeks now, and I have noticed that the texture of my skin as far as my pores and uneven tone has decreased. My pores are smaller tighter less visible. The overall texture of my skin is smoother. The feel is softer and silkier, my tone is more even and bright my complexion very clear. My skin looks plump from the collagen and the PDRN and hydrated. I've been using day and night with my COSRX skin care routine. I highly recommend this addition to your skincare routines. If you want skin that is more plump, firm, hydrated, smooth texture, even bright tone, and clear complexion.

I love this product! Great for layering and my skin immediately feels brighter and more hydrated. The great thing is that my skin doesn't look like I'm wearing a lot of product and my pores feel smoother.

avis.titre: Loving it so far and makes my skin so plump!
avis.texte: Loving it so far!! It makes my skin look so plump and juicy and helps minimize pore size!! My skin definitely feels and looks brighter. I've been using it every morning along with my Peptide Serum, snail mucin serum and snail mucin eye serum from here!! Those are my holy grails!! This is such a great addition!!

This is a lightweight serum that is very hydrating and nourishing. It easily sinks into your skin and leave you feeling supple and comfortable. I use it after an essence and before a heavier cream to lock in the moisture. It gas been very helpful as the weather starts to be colder and drier. I have sensitive and dry skin and have had no irritation with this serum. It layers well and quenches your skin. I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for hydration and nourishment for their skin.

avis.titre: OMG: This Serum Gave Me Baby Soft Skin
avis.texte: I've only been using this new serum for three weeks, but I seriously had to jump on here and talk about it! I usually wait months to review skincare, but this stuff is wonderful. The glow is noticeable—my complexion looks visibly healthier and more luminous. The biggest shocker, though, is how incredibly soft my skin feels. I mean, baby-butt soft. It absorbs fast, layers perfectly under my moisturizer and SPF, and doesn't feels heavy or greasy. If you're looking for that immediate, glassy, soft-texture fix, you should give it a try. **some of my favorite products!!!!

This serum is on the watery side, but there isn't a scent so that is a definite plus for those who are sensitive to smell. I usually use about 4 pumps for my face and neck, but if you use too much at once, your skin could feel a little sticky. This feeling does go away though once you apply your moisturizer, so this isn't a big issue (I'm currently using The Ceramide Skin Barrier Moisturizer). The big win for me though was the fact that I didn't break out once while using this serum. I have super sensitive, acne prone skin and have used this product for almost three weeks now, so the fact I didn't break out says a lot about this serum. Also, my skin has definitely brightened up, and I feel like it is softer than it used to be. Therefore, I definitely recommend this to those who have similar skin type and are looking to transition to a slow aging skin regimen.

I have only been using this product for a couple weeks, but I am already seeing a drastic improvement in my skin's brightness. I definitely recommend this to anyone who is looking to improve the brightness of their skin this winter.

I have been using this every morning for over 3 weeks now. I have sensitive, acne-prone, and oily skin. My typical morning routine is wash my face with a gentle cleanser followed by a serum and then sunscreen. Super simple and has worked well for me. This product fit seamlessly into my routine. I wanted to get the full benefits so I incorporated it in my night time routine as well. I usually use the lowest dose of retinol every night with a hydrating moisturizer, so I decided to taper that down to 1-2x a week. My pores are largest in my t-zone, mainly my cheeks. The retinol definitely has helped clear up the sebaceous filaments, giving the appearance of smaller pores. I wasn't worried this serum would keep up with the appearance because I trust COSRx. I've used this serum day and night consistently for a full week now. This serum feels similar to their Full Fit Propolis Toner. It's not watery. There is more weight to it, like how a serum should feel. A little goes a long way. This absorbs nicely into my skin and there's no scent. Two pumps is enough for my face, neck and chest. The collagen plumped my skin, the niacinamide controlled my oil production - my face looks and feels so healthy. I would definitely purchase this when I'm about to run out. This is perfect especially for the Fall/ Winter seasons as my skin tends to feel a bit dehydrated. Thank you, COSRx, for giving me the opportunity to test this out during your free trial event.

Been using COSRx products for a long time and this probably is one of my fave next to the 6 Peptide booster! My skin is sensitive, fungal-acne prone, and usually dull. I started using the COSRX PDRN Intense Serum at night, and after just a couple of uses I could already feel a difference. My skin feels more hydrated, smoother, and the overall texture has improved. Definitely a winter skincare must-have!

Great new product like almost all other Cosrx products. Applies smoothly but not sticky or too thick. Texture and consistency are great. Just started using it so I don't know what the long term effects will be but so far my skin looks super hydrated and smooth!
